use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE

class BALL is
    row: int public
    slot: int public

    init() is
        row = 0
        slot = 0
    si
si

let rows = 8
let balls = 60
let width = 240
let height = 180

let pin_spacing = 20.0D
let top = 20.0D
let ball_size = 4.0D

let random = System.Random(12)

let bins = repeat(0, rows + 1) |> collect_list()
let falling = LIST[BALL]()

x_of(row: int, slot: int) -> double =>
    let offset = cast double(slot) - cast double(row) / 2.0D in
    cast double(width) / 2.0D + offset * pin_spacing

y_of(row: int) -> double => top + cast double(row) * 11.0D

draw(image: IMAGE) is
    image.clear(245ub, 242ub, 232ub)

    image.colour(90ub, 90ub, 100ub)

    for row in 0..rows do
        for pin in 0::row do
            image.dot(x_of(row, pin), y_of(row), 2.0D)
        od
    od

    let floor = cast double(height - 4)

    image.colour(40ub, 90ub, 160ub)

    for (slot, count) in bins |> index() do
        let x = x_of(rows, slot)

        for i in 0..count do
            let y = floor - ball_size * (cast double(i) + 0.5D)

            image.dot(x, y, ball_size / 2.0D)
        od
    od

    image.colour(200ub, 60ub, 40ub)

    for ball in falling do
        let x = x_of(ball.row, ball.slot)

        image.dot(x, y_of(ball.row) - 5.0D, ball_size / 2.0D)
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(width, height)
let animation = ANIMATION(width, height)
let released mut = 0
let tick mut = 0

while released < balls \/ falling.count > 0 do
    for ball in falling |> filter(b => b.row == rows) |> collect_list() do
        bins[ball.slot] = bins[ball.slot] + 1
        falling.remove(ball)
    od

    for ball in falling do
        ball.row = ball.row + 1

        if random.next(2) == 1 then
            ball.slot = ball.slot + 1
        fi
    od

    if released < balls /\ tick % 2 == 0 then
        falling.add(BALL())
        released = released + 1
    fi

    draw(image)
    animation.add(image, 60)

    tick = tick + 1
od

animation.add(image, 2000)

write_line("{balls} balls through {rows} rows of pins")
write_line("bins: {bins |> join(" ")}")

animation.write("galton.png")

animation.show("galton.png")
